description:
Runa brings your authorized meeting knowledge into ChatGPT. Search meeting summaries and approved folder documents, retrieve recent or topic-matched meetings, review decisions and key takeaways, list open action items, and prepare for upcoming meetings using Runa’s latest synchronized calendar context.

Runa is read-only in ChatGPT. It cannot edit meetings, complete action items, or send messages. Results are limited by the connected user’s Runa access, workspace external-AI policy, and Runa’s public connector safety controls. A Runa account is required. Upcoming meeting info reflects Runa’s latest desktop sync and may not be live.

defaultPrompt: What was my most recent meeting, and what do I need to do next?
What’s my next upcoming meeting, and what should I prepare?
Pull the last call with this customer and summarize commitments we made.
